column1: # This table is the single source of truth for the three classification axes.
# tools/go-by-example/validate.sh loads the vocabularies and the coupling from
# here; it does not hardcode them. Adding a term to an inventory row without
# declaring it here is a fail-closed error.
# The comparison this schema describes is: pinned Go 1.27 reference run vs
# Bash++ run of the SAME pinned bytes. A normalization therefore exists only to
# cancel variance that two separate invocations cannot avoid (wall clock,
# addresses, scheduler interleaving); it never exists to hide a disagreement.
